subject: english
question: Choose the most suitable option to replace the highlighted part of the sentence: No other athlete **was as great as Sachin is**.

options.text: has been as great as Sachin

solution:
The correct answer is '3' i.e. has been as great as Sachin .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence compares Sachin with other athletes, using the superlative structure **"No other athlete was as great as Sachin."**
 
• To replace the highlighted part correctly, the verb tense and comparison structure should align with the context.
 
• Option 3 **"has been as great as Sachin"** uses the correct verb tense and comparison structure to convey the intended meaning.

Correct sentence: *No other athlete **has been as great as Sachin**.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Key Rules for Comparison:**

 
 
• **"As + adjective + as"** is used to show equality in comparison.
 
• For unequal comparisons, we use structures like **"not as...as" or "no other."**
 
• The verb tense in the comparison must match the sentence context.
 
 
 
• **Incorrect Options Analysis:**
 
 
• **Option 1:** "is greater than Sachin" changes the meaning and contradicts the original sentence.
 
• **Option 2:** "is so great like Sachin" is grammatically incorrect; "like" cannot be used in place of "as."
 
• **Option 4:** "was so great like Sachin" is also grammatically incorrect for the same reason as Option 2.
